related_issues.reason: Earlier request to show cache usage/size; context for why `uv cache size` exists, but not the same request (default output format).

rationale: uv cache size works as designed: it prints raw bytes by default and offers --human, as documented in --help. The reporter wants the default flipped to human-readable with a new --bytes flag for scripts. That is a behaviour/design change to a preview-gated command, so it is an enhancement, matching the reporter's label. Searches found no earlier issue requesting the same default change (the original feature request #15821 cited in the body did not appear in search results). #12854 is only loosely related context.
